description: Update one item that belongs to the signed-in person and return the saved item. Unknown fields and server-owned fields are ignored. current_value is only for an item the person owns or has lent out. On a wishlist, borrowed or gift item it is ignored and the result says so in value_note. A wishlist item takes target_price. On a gift, recipient, occasion, gift_date and gift_status can be changed: mark it bought or given with gift_status, and a given gift stays on the gift list. A gift has no value field. A gift cannot be changed to inventory, lent or borrowed; that is refused and nothing is changed.

confirm_market_value.description: Set true only when current_value is the number get_market_value just returned, unchanged. That reading is then marked as a confirmed market value. Leave it out for a number the person typed.

current_value.description: Value of an item the person owns or has lent out. Ignored on wishlist, borrowed and gift items.

gift_date.description: Gift only: the date of the occasion, YYYY-MM-DD. Null clears it. Ignored on every other list.

gift_status.description: Gift only: idea, bought or given. A new gift is idea. given keeps the item on the gift list. Ignored on every other list.

list_type.description: The list the item is on. gift is something the person plans to give someone: it needs recipient, and it cannot later become inventory, lent or borrowed.

occasion.description: Gift only: what the gift is for, such as Christmas or a birthday. Null clears it. Ignored on every other list.

recipient.description: Gift only: who the gift is for. Required when list_type is gift. Ignored on every other list.

remove_collection_id.description: Collection to take the item out of

target_price.description: Wishlist only: the price the person is aiming for. Null clears it. Ignored on every other list.

name: update_item
title: Update item
